metadata.description: Validation test for the GNSS course and ground speed (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T05): in a hover the track is not valid and holds; in forward flight above 3 m/s the true track matches the truth (grid track + γ) within 3° and the ground speed within 0.5 m/s (the 10 Hz hold lags an accelerating vehicle); the magnetic track is the true track minus the WMM declination.
